last.verdict: Huge revenue beat and 1.4 GW pipeline, but shares ended flat.

reasons.label: Revenue far above forecasts
reasons.text: Revenue jumped 322% to $341.9M, versus analyst estimates near $120–132M.

reasons.label: Pricing and leases ahead
reasons.text: Expects about 250 MW of new leases by year-end at 15%+ higher rates.

reasons.label: Heavy debt, ongoing losses
reasons.text: About $6.4B of debt and a $0.82 per-share GAAP loss tempered the enthusiasm.

story: Revenue has beaten forecasts for four straight reports, rising from $126.6M in January to $341.9M now. Reactions were mixed: gains in January and July, a drop in April, and now flat. Heavy debt and a stock down roughly 35% over a year keep investors cautious.
